threading_note: Q.ordered_chunks uses ThreadPoolExecutor, four workers; numerical-library limits are 1. This is not four process workers.
cpu_time_note: RUSAGE_CHILDREN aggregates scorer child including its threads; timing wrapper itself is excluded.
wall_interval_note: Docker create excluded from total_to_terminal; start API through wait-event observed includes startup and teardown. Wrapper process clock and score.report are nested intervals.
